about: Polls added from their original sources because Wikipedia does not have them yet, and the place to add election-night exit polls. Each poll keeps its sources. Column labels are the ones Wikipedia uses, so poll_list_map.py maps them. A poll dated election day counts as an exit poll. When Wikipedia later lists the same poll (same election, pollster, outlet, date within a day), the Wikipedia row is used and this one is skipped. Rebuild: python build_polls_db.py && python generate_poll_accuracy.py
